notes.title: Steam Deck Update
notes.notes: Hello Citizens! I've just pushed an update that finally fixes some graphical glitches that were present in Steam Deck and Mac builds. Occasionally, you might have seen blank lines in the movement grid, or some low-resolution areas. These have now been fixed in the latest v1.3 update, and it looks great on the Deck now! Enjoy!

notes.title: Updates Notes for 22nd January
notes.notes:
Hello, citizens!

I've pushed the same fix for Miasma 1 and 2 - if you were having problems booting the game on Mac, this should be fixed now.

Happy strategising!
David

notes.title: Update Notes for 3rd December, 2021
notes.notes: No game is complete without a Day 1 Patch! I found an odd issue with Windows scaling - if your monitor was set to anything other than 100% display scaling, you could experience blurry graphics or too-large window sizes. This has now been fixed.
